mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mydata_consent( user_id, terms_version, agreed_at, expires_at, revoked_at, agree_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{termsVersion}, #{agreedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{agreeStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT mc.connection_id AS connectionId, fi.financial_institution_name AS institutionName, mc.connection_status AS connectionStatus, mc.expires_at AS expiresAt, mc.synced_at AS lastSyncedAt, mc.connection_status AS syncStatus FROM mydata_connection mc INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON mc.financial_institution_id = fi.financial_institution_id WHERE mc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY mc.synced_at DESC
